svg.title: One update graph cycle, targeted every 1000 ms: collect source table changes, propagate sources first then dependents, each table processes its changes once, listeners run after their table updates, and the UI shows a consistent result. Example: 5 new rows reach t1 in one cycle; t2 updates the affected Label rows and t3 adds the 5 rows and modifies matching rows.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
